$description: Machine-readable style tokens for the Vox-style grayscale+orange collage video DNA. Extracted from vox-style-3 (dungthanhluudhl-ui/vox-style-3), src/scenes/shared.jsx and scripts/process_cutout.py. Use alongside STYLE_DNA.md.

default.note: Vertical short-form default (TikTok/Reels/Shorts). Switch to 16:9 only if explicitly requested.

colors.$note: orange (#FF6A1A, used for UI accents/bottom bar/highlights) and shadowOrange (#ff7a1a, used only for the baked-in cutout drop shadow) are intentionally two near-identical but distinct hex values from the source project — keep both if replicating exactly.

headline.sizingMethod: measure real glyph widths (fitText/measureText), never estimate by character count

safeZone.reason: top reserves space for a social app's profile/follow UI; bottom is the caption band's anchor offset (caption.position.bottom) plus a small margin for multi-line growth — not numerically equal to it

otherVariants.chart: bold ruled horizontal lines (4, at 20/40/60/80% height) + left-edge orange tick marks, for a data/trend scene
otherVariants.card: flat backgroundCard tone, no grid, for a headline/quote scene
otherVariants.spotlight: dark radial vignette (rgba(20,20,20,0.28) at edges) for a warning/consequence beat

background.rule: pick the variant deliberately per scene, don't leave every scene on the default grid

person.grayscaleMethod: PIL ImageOps.autocontrast(convert('L'), cutoff=1) — plain contrast-boosted grayscale, explicitly NOT a halftone dot pattern (tried and rejected)

dropShadow.shape: binarized silhouette of the cutout, baked into the PNG — a crisp solid offset shape, not a soft blurred halo

cutoutTreatment.cropping: crop tightly to content bounds with a small margin before sizing into a layout slot; never leave large transparent padding around the subject
cutoutTreatment.backgroundRemoval: chroma-key when the source has a controlled flat green/magenta screen (AI-generated), ML segmentation (rembg) as fallback for real photos

caption.mountLevel: once at the master/timeline level, using absolute (not scene-local) frame numbers, so it reads continuously through scene cuts
caption.syncSource: word-level ASR timestamps (e.g. Whisper), not manual timing

onScreenLabels.rule: a drawn/on-screen label must never restate the spoken narration word-for-word; it exists to add information the voice doesn't already carry

iconVocabulary.drawStyle: progressively self-drawing SVG paths, same visual language as diagrams — never a static/instant icon
iconVocabulary.rule: if a concept already has a vocabulary icon, use it instead of spelling the concept out as a text label

pacing.openingRule: the opening 15 seconds deserve several distinct beats, not one long establishing shot
